opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Award value and application frequency vary with membership category.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a Society and/or Society-sponsored conference. Covers registration for the conference(s) applied for and attendance at the meeting dinner(s), plus a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation up to the total value of the award on presentation of receipts. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Animal costs, experimental consumables and small equipment purchases are permitted. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Funding cannot be used for salary costs, to attend conferences or for membership payments.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society. Members will normally only be awarded this funding once during their period of membership.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds should be used within 12 months of receipt. Funds cannot be used to pay staff salaries but may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles. Intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
